# API differences

<!-- Generated by `composer generate` from generator/recorded-types.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Productive's OpenAPI spec does not always match what the API returns. `composer record` records real responses (GET only, from a trial organization), `composer record:types` reduces them to the kinds of value each attribute had, and `composer generate` follows the recording where the spec's type cannot read what the API sends. This page lists every difference found in the recording of 2026-10-23.

## Removed

The API no longer has these, so no code is generated for them.

| Resource or relationship | Why |
| --- | --- |
| `boards` | GET /boards returns 404 Route Not Found (recorded 2026-10-09). The official Ruby client dropped its board resource as well; task lists now belong to folders. |
| `task_lists.board` | Task lists now belong to a folder: recorded responses have "folder", not "board". |
| `task_reports.board` | The API rejects include=board on task reports (recorded 2026-10-09), and boards no longer exist. |
